---
title: "Future State Map"
subtitle: "Interactive workspace"
page-layout: full
format:
  html:
    code-copy: false
---

::: {.callout-note}
## Design and measure the future flow

1. Preserve your Current State exports, then load `current_state.drawio` and `current_state_metadata.csv` from `output/` to establish the baseline.
2. Remove unnecessary work and queues, add Kaizen bursts for improvement experiments, and use pull signals where downstream demand should trigger work.
3. Generate a revised layout from a simple `Step A -> Step B` doc2draw-style script, or edit the loaded baseline directly in Draw.io.
4. Select a process component, compare its latest timestamped baseline with editable targets, and append each target update to the in-memory history.
5. Export all diagram formats and the target metadata CSV. Your browser will prompt for downloads; save or move them into `output/`.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof future_map_workspace = {
  const future_drawio_origin = "https://embed.diagrams.net";
  const future_empty_xml =
    '<mxfile host="embed.diagrams.net"><diagram id="future-state" name="Page-1"><mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>';
  const future_fields = [
    {key: "cycle_time", label: "Cycle Time"},
    {key: "changeover_time", label: "Changeover Time"},
    {key: "lead_time", label: "Lead Time", aliases: ["lead_time_days"]},
    {key: "scrap_defect_rate", label: "Scrap / Defect Rate (%)"},
    {key: "funding", label: "Funding Holds", aliases: ["funding_holds"]},
    {key: "code_errors", label: "Code Errors"},
    {key: "data_errors", label: "Data Errors"},
    {key: "security_permissions", label: "Security / Permissions"},
    {key: "approvals", label: "Approvals"}
  ];
  const future_state = {
    xml: future_empty_xml,
    baseline: new Map(),
    history: [],
    export_queue: [],
    active_export: null
  };

  const future_workspace = document.createElement("div");
  future_workspace.className = "future-map-workspace";

  const future_script_card = document.createElement("section");
  future_script_card.className = "future-map-card";
  const future_script_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  future_script_heading.textContent = "Option A: Generate an updated flow from text";
  const future_script_help = document.createElement("p");
  future_script_help.textContent =
    "Enter doc2draw-style process text, one step per line or connected with ->. Include pull signals and Kaizen bursts as labeled steps or annotations, then refine the generated flow below.";
  const future_script = document.createElement("textarea");
  future_script.className = "future-script";
  future_script.setAttribute("aria-label", "Future State text-to-diagram script");
  future_script.value =
    "Customer pull signal -> Validate request -> Perform streamlined process -> Quality at source -> Deliver";
  const future_create_diagram = future_button("Create Future State diagram");
  future_script_card.append(
    future_script_heading,
    future_script_help,
    future_script,
    future_create_diagram
  );

  const future_editor_card = document.createElement("section");
  future_editor_card.className = "future-map-card";
  const future_editor_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  future_editor_heading.textContent = "Option B: Load a baseline and edit in Draw.io";
  const future_editor_help = document.createElement("p");
  future_editor_help.textContent =
    "Load the editable .drawio file exported by the Current State workspace, or begin with an empty canvas. Changes remain in this browser tab until exported.";
  const future_editor_controls = document.createElement("div");
  future_editor_controls.className = "future-map-controls";
  const future_load_diagram = future_button("Load Current State Diagram");
  const future_diagram_file = document.createElement("input");
  future_diagram_file.type = "file";
  future_diagram_file.accept = ".drawio,.xml,application/xml,text/xml";
  future_diagram_file.hidden = true;
  const future_export_all = future_button("Export all diagram formats");
  const future_export_help = document.createElement("span");
  future_export_help.textContent =
    "Downloads future_state.drawio, future_state.drawio.svg, and future_state.png. Place them in output/.";
  future_editor_controls.append(
    future_load_diagram,
    future_diagram_file,
    future_export_all,
    future_export_help
  );
  const future_frame = document.createElement("iframe");
  future_frame.className = "future-drawio-frame";
  future_frame.title = "Draw.io Future State Map editor";
  future_frame.src =
    `${future_drawio_origin}/?embed=1&proto=json&spin=1&autosave=1&saveAndExit=0&noSaveBtn=1&libraries=1`;
  future_editor_card.append(
    future_editor_heading,
    future_editor_help,
    future_editor_controls,
    future_frame
  );

  const future_metadata_card = document.createElement("section");
  future_metadata_card.className = "future-map-card";
  const future_metadata_details = document.createElement("details");
  future_metadata_details.className = "future-metadata-panel";
  future_metadata_details.open = true;
  const future_metadata_summary = document.createElement("summary");
  future_metadata_summary.textContent = "Target metadata and gap analysis";
  const future_metadata_help = document.createElement("p");
  future_metadata_help.textContent =
    "Load the Current State CSV, then select a component. The latest valid ISO timestamp for each component supplies its read-only baseline.";
  const future_metadata_controls = document.createElement("div");
  future_metadata_controls.className = "future-map-controls";
  const future_load_metadata = future_button("Load Current State Metadata CSV");
  const future_metadata_file = document.createElement("input");
  future_metadata_file.type = "file";
  future_metadata_file.accept = ".csv,text/csv";
  future_metadata_file.hidden = true;
  const future_component_label = document.createElement("label");
  future_component_label.textContent = "Process component";
  const future_component = document.createElement("input");
  future_component.type = "text";
  future_component.setAttribute("list", "future-component-options");
  future_component.setAttribute("aria-label", "Process component");
  const future_component_list = document.createElement("datalist");
  future_component_list.id = "future-component-options";
  future_component_label.append(document.createElement("br"), future_component);
  future_metadata_controls.append(
    future_load_metadata,
    future_metadata_file,
    future_component_label,
    future_component_list
  );

  const future_baseline_note = document.createElement("p");
  future_baseline_note.textContent = "No Current State metadata loaded.";
  const future_field_grid = document.createElement("div");
  future_field_grid.className = "future-field-grid";
  const future_gap_heading = document.createElement("h3");
  future_gap_heading.textContent = "Live gap analysis";
  const future_gap_help = document.createElement("p");
  future_gap_help.textContent =
    "Use the same units in each baseline/target pair. Defect/error reduction combines available numeric Scrap, Code Error, and Data Error pairs.";
  const future_gap_grid = document.createElement("div");
  future_gap_grid.className = "future-gap-grid";
  const future_gap_outputs = new Map();
  [
    ["cycle_time_reduction", "Cycle Time Reduction"],
    ["lead_time_reduction", "Lead Time Reduction"],
    ["defect_error_reduction", "Defect / Error Reduction"]
  ].forEach(([key, label]) => {
    const result = document.createElement("div");
    result.className = "future-gap-result";
    const heading = document.createElement("strong");
    heading.textContent = label;
    const output = document.createElement("output");
    output.textContent = "Not available";
    result.append(heading, output);
    future_gap_grid.append(result);
    future_gap_outputs.set(key, output);
  });
  const future_record_controls = document.createElement("div");
  future_record_controls.className = "future-map-controls";
  const future_save_metadata = future_button("Append Target Metadata");
  const future_export_metadata = future_button("Export Target Metadata to CSV");
  future_record_controls.append(future_save_metadata, future_export_metadata);
  const future_history = document.createElement("code");
  future_history.className = "future-history";
  future_history.textContent = "No target metadata records saved yet.";
  future_metadata_details.append(
    future_metadata_summary,
    future_metadata_help,
    future_metadata_controls,
    future_baseline_note,
    future_field_grid,
    future_gap_heading,
    future_gap_help,
    future_gap_grid,
    future_record_controls,
    future_history
  );
  future_metadata_card.append(future_metadata_details);

  const future_status = document.createElement("p");
  future_status.className = "future-status";
  future_status.setAttribute("role", "status");
  future_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  future_workspace.append(
    future_script_card,
    future_editor_card,
    future_metadata_card,
    future_status
  );

  function future_button(label) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = label;
    return button;
  }

  function future_notify(message) {
    future_status.textContent = message;
  }

  function future_post(message) {
    future_frame.contentWindow?.postMessage(
      JSON.stringify(message),
      future_drawio_origin
    );
  }

  function future_load_xml(xml, title = "Future State Map") {
    future_state.xml = xml;
    future_post({
      action: "load",
      autosave: 1,
      modified: "unsavedChanges",
      xml,
      title
    });
  }

  function future_escape_xml(value) {
    return String(value)
      .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
      .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
      .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
      .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
      .replaceAll("'", "&apos;");
  }

  function future_parse_script(script) {
    const nodes = [];
    const edges = [];
    const node_index = new Map();
    const add_node = (label) => {
      const clean_label = label.trim();
      if (!clean_label) return null;
      if (!node_index.has(clean_label)) {
        node_index.set(clean_label, nodes.length);
        nodes.push(clean_label);
      }
      return node_index.get(clean_label);
    };
    script.split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach((line) => {
      const labels = line.split(/\s*->\s*/).filter(Boolean);
      labels.forEach(add_node);
      for (let index = 0; index < labels.length - 1; index += 1) {
        edges.push([add_node(labels[index]), add_node(labels[index + 1])]);
      }
    });
    if (edges.length === 0) {
      for (let index = 0; index < nodes.length - 1; index += 1) {
        edges.push([index, index + 1]);
      }
    }
    return {nodes, edges};
  }

  function future_xml_from_script(script) {
    const parsed = future_parse_script(script);
    if (parsed.nodes.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("Enter at least one process step.");
    }
    const cells = parsed.nodes.map((label, index) => {
      const x = 60 + (index % 4) * 240;
      const y = 80 + Math.floor(index / 4) * 150;
      return `<mxCell id="future-node-${index}" value="${future_escape_xml(label)}" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="${x}" y="${y}" width="170" height="60" as="geometry"/></mxCell>`;
    });
    parsed.edges.forEach(([source, target], index) => {
      cells.push(`<mxCell id="future-edge-${index}" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;" edge="1" parent="1" source="future-node-${source}" target="future-node-${target}"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell>`);
    });
    future_add_component_options(parsed.nodes);
    return `<mxfile host="embed.diagrams.net"><diagram id="future-state" name="Page-1"><mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>${cells.join("")}</root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>`;
  }

  future_create_diagram.addEventListener("click", () => {
    try {
      future_load_xml(future_xml_from_script(future_script.value));
      future_notify("Created a Future State starting diagram from the process script.");
    } catch (error) {
      future_notify(error.message);
    }
  });

  future_load_diagram.addEventListener("click", () => future_diagram_file.click());
  future_diagram_file.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const file = future_diagram_file.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
        throw new Error("Choose a Current State diagram smaller than 10 MB.");
      }
      const xml = await file.text();
      const document_xml = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, "application/xml");
      if (
        document_xml.querySelector("parsererror") ||
        !["mxfile", "mxGraphModel"].includes(document_xml.documentElement.tagName)
      ) {
        throw new Error("The selected file is not a valid Draw.io XML diagram.");
      }
      future_load_xml(xml);
      future_notify(`Loaded ${file.name} as the Future State baseline.`);
    } catch (error) {
      future_notify(error.message);
    } finally {
      future_diagram_file.value = "";
    }
  });

  function future_download_url(url, filename) {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.append(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
  }

  function future_download_blob(blob, filename) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    future_download_url(url, filename);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  function future_request_next_export() {
    const format = future_state.export_queue.shift();
    if (!format) {
      future_export_all.disabled = false;
      future_notify("All diagram downloads are ready. Save or move them into output/.");
      return;
    }
    future_state.active_export = format;
    future_post({
      action: "export",
      format,
      xml: future_state.xml,
      spinKey: "export"
    });
  }

  future_export_all.addEventListener("click", () => {
    future_export_all.disabled = true;
    future_download_blob(
      new Blob([future_state.xml], {type: "application/xml;charset=utf-8"}),
      "future_state.drawio"
    );
    future_state.export_queue = ["xmlsvg", "xmlpng"];
    future_notify("Preparing editable SVG and PNG exports…");
    future_request_next_export();
  });

  function future_handle_message(event) {
    if (
      event.origin !== future_drawio_origin ||
      event.source !== future_frame.contentWindow
    ) return;
    let message;
    try {
      message = typeof event.data === "string" ? JSON.parse(event.data) : event.data;
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (message.event === "init") {
      future_load_xml(future_state.xml);
      future_notify("Draw.io editor ready.");
    } else if (message.event === "autosave" || message.event === "save") {
      if (message.xml) future_state.xml = message.xml;
    } else if (message.event === "export" && message.data) {
      const filename =
        future_state.active_export === "xmlsvg"
          ? "future_state.drawio.svg"
          : "future_state.png";
      future_download_url(message.data, filename);
      future_request_next_export();
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener("message", future_handle_message);

  function future_parse_csv(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [];
    let field = "";
    let quoted = false;
    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const character = text[index];
      if (quoted) {
        if (character === '"' && text[index + 1] === '"') {
          field += '"';
          index += 1;
        } else if (character === '"') {
          quoted = false;
        } else {
          field += character;
        }
      } else if (character === '"') {
        quoted = true;
      } else if (character === ",") {
        row.push(field);
        field = "";
      } else if (character === "\n") {
        row.push(field);
        rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        field = "";
      } else if (character !== "\r") {
        field += character;
      }
    }
    if (quoted) throw new Error("The CSV contains an unclosed quoted value.");
    if (field || row.length) {
      row.push(field);
      rows.push(row);
    }
    if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error("The CSV has no metadata records.");
    const headers = rows[0].map((header, index) =>
      (index === 0 ? header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "") : header).trim()
    );
    if (!headers.includes("timestamp") || !headers.includes("component")) {
      throw new Error("The CSV must contain timestamp and component columns.");
    }
    return rows.slice(1)
      .filter((values) => values.some((value) => value !== ""))
      .map((values) => Object.fromEntries(
        headers.map((header, index) => [header, values[index] ?? ""])
      ));
  }

  function future_add_component_options(components) {
    const names = new Set([
      ...future_state.baseline.keys(),
      ...[...future_component_list.options].map((option) => option.value),
      ...components
    ]);
    future_component_list.replaceChildren(
      ...[...names].sort().map((name) => {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = name;
        return option;
      })
    );
  }

  function future_baseline_value(record, field) {
    if (!record) return "";
    for (const key of [field.key, ...(field.aliases || [])]) {
      if (record[key] !== undefined && record[key] !== "") return record[key];
    }
    return "";
  }

  function future_latest_target(component) {
    return [...future_state.history].reverse().find(
      (record) => record.component === component
    );
  }

  function future_render_fields() {
    const component = future_component.value.trim();
    const baseline = future_state.baseline.get(component);
    const latest_target = future_latest_target(component);
    future_baseline_note.textContent = baseline
      ? `Baseline for ${component}: latest record at ${baseline.timestamp}.`
      : component
        ? `No baseline record found for ${component}.`
        : "Load metadata and select a process component.";
    future_field_grid.replaceChildren();
    future_fields.forEach((field) => {
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "future-field-row";
      const heading = document.createElement("strong");
      heading.textContent = field.label;
      const baseline_label = document.createElement("label");
      baseline_label.textContent = "Baseline";
      const baseline_input = document.createElement("input");
      baseline_input.type = "text";
      baseline_input.readOnly = true;
      baseline_input.value = future_baseline_value(baseline, field);
      baseline_input.dataset.baselineKey = field.key;
      baseline_label.append(baseline_input);
      const target_label = document.createElement("label");
      target_label.textContent = "Target";
      const target_input = document.createElement("input");
      target_input.type = "text";
      target_input.value = latest_target?.[field.key] ?? "";
      target_input.dataset.targetKey = field.key;
      target_input.addEventListener("input", future_render_gaps);
      target_label.append(target_input);
      row.append(heading, baseline_label, target_label);
      future_field_grid.append(row);
    });
    future_render_gaps();
  }

  function future_values(selector, key_name) {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      [...future_field_grid.querySelectorAll(selector)].map((input) => [
        input.dataset[key_name],
        input.value
      ])
    );
  }

  function future_number(value) {
    const match = String(value ?? "").replaceAll(",", "").match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/);
    return match ? Number(match[0]) : NaN;
  }

  function future_reduction(baseline, target) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(baseline) || !Number.isFinite(target) || baseline === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    return ((baseline - target) / baseline) * 100;
  }

  function future_format_reduction(value) {
    return value === null ? "Not available" : `${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
  }

  function future_gap_values() {
    const baseline = future_values("[data-baseline-key]", "baselineKey");
    const target = future_values("[data-target-key]", "targetKey");
    const cycle = future_reduction(
      future_number(baseline.cycle_time),
      future_number(target.cycle_time)
    );
    const lead = future_reduction(
      future_number(baseline.lead_time),
      future_number(target.lead_time)
    );
    const error_keys = ["scrap_defect_rate", "code_errors", "data_errors"];
    const error_pairs = error_keys
      .map((key) => [future_number(baseline[key]), future_number(target[key])])
      .filter(([base, goal]) => Number.isFinite(base) && Number.isFinite(goal));
    const defect = error_pairs.length
      ? future_reduction(
          error_pairs.reduce((sum, [base]) => sum + base, 0),
          error_pairs.reduce((sum, [, goal]) => sum + goal, 0)
        )
      : null;
    return {
      cycle_time_reduction: cycle,
      lead_time_reduction: lead,
      defect_error_reduction: defect
    };
  }

  function future_render_gaps() {
    const gaps = future_gap_values();
    Object.entries(gaps).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      future_gap_outputs.get(key).textContent = future_format_reduction(value);
    });
  }

  future_load_metadata.addEventListener("click", () => future_metadata_file.click());
  future_metadata_file.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const file = future_metadata_file.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        throw new Error("Choose a Current State metadata CSV smaller than 5 MB.");
      }
      const records = future_parse_csv(await file.text());
      const baseline = new Map();
      records.forEach((record) => {
        const component = record.component.trim();
        const timestamp = Date.parse(record.timestamp);
        if (!component || !Number.isFinite(timestamp)) return;
        const existing = baseline.get(component);
        if (!existing || timestamp > Date.parse(existing.timestamp)) {
          baseline.set(component, record);
        }
      });
      if (baseline.size === 0) {
        throw new Error("No records have both a component and valid timestamp.");
      }
      future_state.baseline = baseline;
      future_add_component_options([]);
      if (!future_state.baseline.has(future_component.value.trim())) {
        future_component.value = future_state.baseline.keys().next().value;
      }
      future_render_fields();
      future_notify(
        `Loaded latest baselines for ${future_state.baseline.size} process components.`
      );
    } catch (error) {
      future_notify(error.message);
    } finally {
      future_metadata_file.value = "";
    }
  });

  future_component.addEventListener("change", future_render_fields);

  function future_render_history() {
    future_history.textContent = future_state.history.length
      ? future_state.history
          .map((record) => `${record.timestamp} — ${record.component}`)
          .join("\n")
      : "No target metadata records saved yet.";
  }

  future_save_metadata.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const component = future_component.value.trim();
    if (!component) {
      future_notify("Select or enter a process component before saving targets.");
      future_component.focus();
      return;
    }
    const baseline = future_state.baseline.get(component);
    const targets = future_values("[data-target-key]", "targetKey");
    const gaps = future_gap_values();
    const record = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      component,
      baseline_timestamp: baseline?.timestamp ?? "",
      ...targets,
      ...Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(gaps).map(([key, value]) => [
          key,
          value === null ? "" : value.toFixed(1)
        ])
      )
    };
    future_state.history.push(record);
    future_add_component_options([component]);
    future_render_history();
    future_workspace.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    future_notify(`Appended target metadata for ${component}.`);
  });

  function future_csv_value(value) {
    return `"${String(value ?? "").replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
  }

  future_export_metadata.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (future_state.history.length === 0) {
      future_notify("Append at least one target metadata record before exporting.");
      return;
    }
    const columns = [
      "timestamp",
      "component",
      "baseline_timestamp",
      ...future_fields.map((field) => field.key),
      "cycle_time_reduction",
      "lead_time_reduction",
      "defect_error_reduction"
    ];
    const lines = [
      columns.map(future_csv_value).join(","),
      ...future_state.history.map((record) =>
        columns.map((column) => future_csv_value(record[column])).join(",")
      )
    ];
    future_download_blob(
      new Blob([lines.join("\r\n")], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"}),
      "future_state_target_metadata.csv"
    );
    future_notify("Target metadata history CSV ready. Save or move it into output/.");
  });

  Object.defineProperty(future_workspace, "value", {
    get: () => ({
      xml: future_state.xml,
      baseline: Object.fromEntries(future_state.baseline),
      history: structuredClone(future_state.history)
    })
  });

  future_render_fields();
  return future_workspace;
}
```
